name: layout5
description: cute girly scrapbook collage with fruit/motif-themed background. The background is a blurred fabric or wallpaper pattern — adapt this pattern to visually match the dominant motif or color of the outfit (e.g. strawberry print outfit → strawberry pattern background; floral outfit → floral wallpaper; plain pastel outfit → soft grid notebook paper). Bright clean color grade, white and red as base accent colors unless outfit dictates otherwise. The layout contains 5 photo slots: one polaroid upper-left (close-up face/portrait), one borderless photo upper-right (half body), one large freeform cutout center with white outline silhouette (full body, dominant element), one small photo lower-left (product detail or accessory flat lay), one photo lower-right inside a Fujifilm digital camera screen mockup (half body). Decorative elements include red-and-white gingham ribbon bow (upper area), clover leaf sticker (upper-left corner), fruit sticker matching outfit motif (strawberry/cherry/peach — match to outfit color), red strawberry hair clip product cutouts, beaded bracelet product cutout (lower-left), pixel-art retro text widget 'all day with me' (lower-left), diagonal script text 'Strawberry girlie' or equivalent motif label (lower-right). White grid notebook paper texture layered behind some elements. Follow the exact number, shape, and arrangement of photo slots shown in the layout reference.
swipe_cta: Add a cute rounded badge or sticker containing a short swipe-related CTA (such as 'Swipe →' or another concise variation). Keep it playful and subtle, complemented by tiny motif-matching icons (fruit, flower, or ribbon), sparkles, or hand-drawn arrows.
